name: trip-fund-solidity
description: ERC-20 trip crowdfunding with a transparent proxy V1 to V2 upgrade

scripts.validate:upgrade: forge build --force && openzeppelin-upgrades-core validate out/build-info --contract src/TripFundV1.sol:TripFundV1 --unsafeAllow constructor && openzeppelin-upgrades-core validate out/build-info --contract src/TripFundV2.sol:TripFundV2 --reference src/TripFundV1.sol:TripFundV1 --requireReference --unsafeAllow constructor
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test && npm run validate:upgrade
